definitions.explanation: A sound of high pitch or frequency. Used for music, singing, audio equipment, and sounds in general.

examples.japanese: {高音|こうおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I can't hit the high notes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スピーカー→スピーカー：04420_supiikaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高音|こうおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{透|す}き{通|とお}る→透き通る：14316_sukitooru⟧ような{高音|こうおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{歌|うた}い{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: She sang with a crystal-clear high voice.

notes:
Used in both musical and general acoustic contexts. In music, can refer to high notes in singing or the treble range of instruments and audio equipment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高音|こうおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to produce/hit high notes
- {高音|こうおん}{域|いき}: high-frequency range; treble range
- {高音|こうおん}⟦パート→パート：03106_paato⟧: high-voice part (in choir)
- {高音|こうおん}{質|しつ}: treble quality

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{低音|ていおん}→低音：18282_teion⟧: low-pitched sound; bass
- {中音|ちゅうおん}: mid-range sound
- ⟦{音域|おんいき}→音域：21730_oniki⟧: vocal/pitch range
- ⟦{高温|こうおん}→高温：14705_kouon⟧: high temperature (homophone — different kanji)
